description:
Adds a public comment to a post or event for the signed-in user; everyone can see it immediately.
postId and postGeoHash come from a search result, get_post or create_post. To attach images, first call get_publishing_media_keys and pass the returned keys as medias.
Returns the new comment's id with the post it belongs to. Velocity limit: 10 per 10 minutes and 200 per day.
Retries: make up an idempotencyKey and resend it if the call fails or times out, so a retry cannot post twice.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you make up once and resend on retry, at most 128 characters: a repeat answers what the first call made instead of posting twice; a reused key with other arguments is refused.

medias.description: Media keys from get_publishing_media_keys, at most 10.

message.description: Text of the comment, at most 3000 characters.

postGeoHash.description: geoHash of that post, returned next to its id by the search and create tools.

postId.description: UUID of the post or event to comment on.

name: create_comment

postGeoHash.description: GeoHash of that post; pass it with postId to get_post.
